dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Collective of Plenty and the Flower-Feather Clan...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's heard that everyone from the Collective of Plenty is built like a bricklayer!

choices.text: Does that mean you'll become Buffmon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No! Paimon likes herself the way she is now.

choices.text: Okay, then what about staying with the Flower-Feather Clan instead? They're adept fliers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But... isn't Paimon good enough at flying already?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, but then you'd be able to carry me when you fly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope, not happening! How would that even be possible?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, if you had those muscles I talked about...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, geez, not this again... For the last time, no!

choices.text: I'm sure they could help you sharpen your skills!
...if you were to stay there awhile, Paimon?
